clayresearch.delta: Cross-branch conformance must distinguish provenance-chain integrity from semantic-preservation evidence. A self-consistent wrong lowering is a first-class counterexample.

frank.delta: No FRANK architecture promotion. H2 implementation evidence must include independent semantic-preservation receipts before claiming reference equivalence.

gwt.delta: Compiled GWT witnesses need both source-chain provenance and a semantic oracle for intended transition/outcome behavior.

emergenz.delta: No emergence claim change. Compiler-chain consistency is not causal/mechanistic validation.

claycode.delta: Expose content-addressed parser-semantics identity and translation/semantic-validation receipts. Grammar hash and provenance continuity alone cannot establish compiler correctness.

hyperposition.delta: Future compiled higher-order/topology witnesses inherit the separate semantic-preservation requirement.

claygraph.delta: Future compiled GraphDelta/Assembly witnesses require semantic preservation, not only chain identity.

unifieddb.delta: Future compiled transaction/ViewDelta witnesses require semantic preservation, not only chain identity.

harness.delta: Current SourceChainEvidence target is v1.2: v1 provenance continuity + v1.1 parser_semantics_hash + v1.2 independent semantic-preservation receipt. H2 differential PASS must not be based only on final state or self-consistent hashes.
